content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting University
content_sections.text: Tamil University is located in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu (Thanjavur – 613 010, as printed on its notice). This recruitment is for its Music Department, which has advertised the two posts on a self-finance basis. The notice is issued by the Registrar (i/c) of the University.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for 2 posts of Honorary Assistant Professor (Self-Finance), one in each subject listed below. The notice gives no category-wise break-up for the two posts. It states that the Tamil Nadu Government 200-point reservation roster will be followed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The qualifications are subject to the regulations of the University Grants Commission (UGC Regulations). Only candidates who have NET/SLET/Ph.D. (Awarded) in the concerned subjects may apply. Work experience is not a stated requirement, but the application form has a column for work experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: 1) Postgraduate degree (Muthukalai) in Music with 55% marks. 2) NET or SET pass. /OR/ 3) Ph.D. in Music.
1) Postgraduate degree (Muthukalai) in Bharatanatyam with 55% marks. 2) NET or SET pass. /OR/ 3) Ph.D. in Bharatanatyam.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The monthly consolidated pay of an Honorary Assistant Professor is Rs.30,000/- only. The notice names no allowances. The appointment of Honorary Assistant Professor is entirely temporary. No claim to a permanent appointment can be made on the basis of this appointment. If the work of the Honorary Assistant Professor is not satisfactory, the person may be relieved from service at any time. The appointment and the interview are subject to the rules of the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tamil University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are sent on paper to the Registrar. The notice gives these steps: Download the information for applicants and the application form from the University website, www.tamiluniversity.ac.in (the form is also printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice). Fill in the application form and tick the department applied for: Music Department (Vocal) or Music Department (Bharatanatyam). Attach attested copies of all certificates – educational qualification, community certificate and other certificates. Take the application fee as a Demand Draft in favour of the Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur, and enclose it with the form. Send the application to Registrar (i/c), Tamil University, Thanjavur - 613 010. Make sure the application reaches the Registrar's office by 10 December 2026, 5.00 PM. The fee is paid only by Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Registrar (i/c), Tamil University, Thanjavur" (page 2 of the notice; the note on the application form writes "Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur"), enclosed with the application. The notice does not say whether the fee is refundable. Post applied for (tick Vocal or Bharatanatyam), full name, and male/female. Address, mobile number and email address. Date of birth and age. rows.details: Application form for the Honorary Assistant Professor posts

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Tamil University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Honorary Assistant Professor (Self-Finance) in the Music Department, one in Vocal and one in Bharatanatyam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Registrar's office of Tamil University, Thanjavur by 10 December 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Vocal and Bharatanatyam posts?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in the subject (Music or Bharatanatyam) with 55% marks and a NET or SET pass, or a Ph.D. in the subject; only candidates with NET/SLET/Ph.D. (Awarded) in the concerned subject may apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an Honorary Assistant Professor at Tamil University?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated pay is Rs.30,000/- only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.200/- for the General category and Rs.100/- for Scheduled Caste candidates, paid by Demand Draft in favour of the Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.tamiluniversity.ac.in, fill it in, attach attested certificate copies and the fee Demand Draft, and send it to Registrar (i/c), Tamil University, Thanjavur - 613 010 to reach by 10 December 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The notice refers to an interview, which is subject to the University's rules, and states that the Tamil Nadu Government 200-point reservation roster will be followed.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Honorary Assistant Professor post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is entirely temporary, it cannot be used to claim a permanent appointment, and the person may be relieved at any time if the work is not satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Will travelling allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no travelling or daily allowance will be given to candidates attending the interview.
